author: reek
body: Ordering a character is refused at CHECK. Unlike the Text case this one is well defined and misleads instead: CCE numbers characters by English letter frequency, so 'd' is 22 and 'b' is 32 and `'d' < 'b'` answered True. Code that wants code-point arithmetic writes char-code and compares Integers, which says what it is doing.

author: reek
body: The Text case is a separate file, so that neither refusal can stand in for the other.
